definitions.gloss: monetary offering at a shrine or temple
definitions.explanation: Money offered to deities or Buddha at shrines and temples. Visitors toss coins into the offering box as part of worship.

examples.japanese: ⟦{賽銭箱|さいせんばこ}→賽銭箱：24468_saisenbako⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせた→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧。
examples.english: I put money in the offering box and put my hands together in prayer.

examples.japanese: {賽銭|さいせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{五円玉|ごえんだま}→五円玉：29055_goendama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many people use five-yen coins for offerings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初詣|はつもうで}→初詣：05804_hatsumoude⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{賽銭|さいせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{列|れつ}→列：02171_retsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: During New Year's shrine visits, lines form to make offerings.

notes:
WORSHIP PROCEDURE:
1. Approach the ⟦{賽銭箱|さいせんばこ}→賽銭箱：24468_saisenbako⟧ (offering box)
2. Toss in your offering
3. Ring the bell (if present)
4. Bow twice, clap twice, bow once (at Shinto shrines)
5. Make your prayer

POPULAR COINS:
- ⟦{五円|ごえん}→五円：noentry⟧ (5 yen): Popular because ⟦{五円|ごえん}→五円：noentry⟧ sounds like ⟦{ご縁|ごえん}→ご縁：08773_goen⟧ (good fortune/connection)
- Any amount is acceptable

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{賽銭箱|さいせんばこ}→賽銭箱：24468_saisenbako⟧: offering box
- ⟦{賽銭泥棒|さいせんどろぼう}→賽銭泥棒：noentry⟧: offering box thief

NOTE:
The amount offered is less important than the sincerity of the prayer.
